name: facts
title: Facts
description: Short facts about one thing, each a small hairline box with its name and value, so a row of them wraps cleanly.
use_for: What a namespace, a connection or a key is, at the top of its panel.
never: More than six in a row

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
// Short facts about one thing (console2.css .v2-fact): each a small hairline box with its name, muted, and its value,
// so a row of them wraps cleanly. Pass `facts`, or write Fact in the slot. `mono` sets a value in Geist Mono (a domain,
// an ID). Six at most; a value that needs a sentence is not a fact.
import Fact from '@/components/ui/Fact.vue'

export type FactItem = { name: string, value: string, mono?: boolean }
defineProps<{ facts?: FactItem[] }>()
</script>

<template>
  <dl data-ds="facts" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <slot><Fact v-for="f in facts" :key="f.name" :name="f.name" :value="f.value" :mono="f.mono" /></slot>
  </dl>
</template>

examples.name: Product
examples.label: In the product
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Facts from '@/components/ui/Facts.vue'
// Short facts about a sign-in connection, each its own small box, so a row of them wraps cleanly.
const facts = [
  { name: 'Provider', value: 'Okta' },
  { name: 'Protocol', value: 'SAML' },
  { name: 'Domain', value: 'acme.com', mono: true },
  { name: 'Last sign-in', value: '2 h ago' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Facts :facts="facts" class="justify-center" />
</template>
